claim: Separating native common leaf hits from the miss helper improves coherent reads even without a larger cache.
mechanism: The native default traverses a template cache-level dispatcher. A small common-hit entry point may improve code layout independently of retaining additional leaves.
prediction: All paired split_only/stock read time ratios below one on coherent64, with the same 96-byte accessor and original parent caches.
falsification: Mixed paired directions or no improvement; larger/cache-collision/churn workloads identify regressions.
change: Use the explicit inline-hit and non-inline-miss layout with the stock single-leaf/parent caches and no secondary slots or activity guard.
result: read: stock 3.595029, split_only 3.788847 ns/op; paired time ratio range 0.9934 to 1.0633.
maintainability: Experimental header overlay; generic library integration and additional platforms remain unvalidated.
codeComments: Patch comments state cache collision checks, invalidation and mask-word conditions.
decisionRationale: Classifies the bounded transfer experiment. Guardrail workload results determine upstream suitability; no production patch is installed.
risks: One Windows x64 compiler and processor.

claim: The common-hit layout alone improves native coherent writes.
mechanism: Reduce common-path dispatcher code while retaining unconditional activity updates and stock cache storage.
prediction: All paired split_only/stock write time ratios below one on coherent64.
falsification: Mixed paired directions or no improvement; guardrail regressions limit suitability.
change: Use only the explicit hit/miss layout; no secondary cache and no mask guard.
result: write: stock 5.038738, split_only 5.246308 ns/op; paired time ratio range 0.9612 to 1.1330.
maintainability: Experimental header overlay; generic library integration and additional platforms remain unvalidated.
